messages.content: Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a fish being pulled out of the water by a human and made to stare at the solar eclipse. Copy the span of words that lies between (and including) index 5 and 15, the indices are word indices, split by whitespace!

message.content:
FADE IN:

EXT. LAKE - DAY

The water is a mirror of chaos, rippling under the weight of an unseen giant. A HAND, weathered and strong, breaches the surface. It grips the tail of a silver TROUT with desperate precision. The fish thrashes, its scales catching the dimming light, but it is no match for the pull. The hand yanks the creature upward, breaking the tension of the water line. For a moment, the trout hangs suspended in the air, gasping, its gills flaring in the dry atmosphere. The human holds it steady, tilting the head back, forcing the fish to look up. Above them, the sky has turned a bruised purple. The sun is being devoured by the moon, a perfect black circle surrounded by a corona of white fire. The trout stares into the void, its eye wide and unblinking, reflecting the impossible darkness. The world goes silent. The only sound is the wet slap of the fish's tail against the air. The eclipse completes itself. Totality. The fish sees the stars appear during the day. It sees the end of the light. And then, slowly, gently, the human lowers it back into the deep.
